tokens.name: d20-teal
tokens.usage: Primary brand color (40% of a composition). Hero/full-bleed slides, headlines on white, primary buttons, the logo.

tokens.name: d20-yellow
tokens.usage: Accent. Speech-bubble cards, feature-row labels, phase 3 cards. Text on it is d20-deck-purple or d20-black, never white.

tokens.name: d20-purple
tokens.usage: Brand-book purple (Stories category) for web UI.

tokens.name: d20-deck-purple
tokens.usage: Muted indigo used throughout the pitch deck: card headers, competitor columns, KPI chips, text on yellow.

tokens.name: d20-coral
tokens.usage: Accent / Activities. Card headers, bar charts, phase 2, highlight chips (e.g. '20% Equity').

tokens.name: d20-coral-deep
tokens.usage: Darker coral for stacked/offset card layers (Revenue Streams back panel).

tokens.name: d20-green
tokens.usage: Accent / Toys. Card headers, 'on track' chips, top bar in charts.

tokens.name: d20-teal-light
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for teal category cards.

tokens.name: d20-yellow-light
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for yellow notice strips.

tokens.name: d20-purple-light
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for purple category cards.

tokens.name: d20-coral-light
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for coral category cards.

tokens.name: d20-green-light
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for green category cards.

tokens.name: d20-teal-dark
tokens.usage: Links and teal text on light tints where #1ABBBC is too light.

tokens.name: d20-black
tokens.usage: Data and numbers on white.

tokens.name: d20-grey-70
tokens.usage: Body copy on white (brand book: body = 70% grey).

tokens.name: d20-grey-50
tokens.usage: Captions, sources, faint labels (large sizes only).

tokens.name: d20-grey-cell
tokens.usage: Neutral cells in comparison tables and stat-chip captions in the deck.

tokens.usage: Borders and dividers.

tokens.name: d20-white
tokens.usage: Slide ground; text on teal, coral, purple, green.
